annotations.title: Sync calls to the board now

description: Sync now: read the call log from the PBX and write each new call as a row on the mapped board, as the signed-in user, through the board's normal path (so the board's automations run for every new row). Safe to repeat: a call already written is never written twice (deduped by the PBX call id), and a call the board refused is retried on the next run. With no range it reads from the saved position, otherwise from and to (local days, up to 31 days back) as a catch-up that leaves the position alone. At most 500 rows per run; run again for the rest. Look with preview_telephony_sync first. Needs a connected, mapped connection. Owner or admin of the app.
